elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph expressly applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or termination of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The other Parties must provide assistance for not less than 90 days, but there is no six-month assistance period.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not state any rate or charge for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The other Parties must export and deliver within 30 days all data and records belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No standard machine-readable format is required.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no deletion or deletion-certification obligation.
